/.name: Home
/.lead: Your whole day at a glance. **What's due today, how far you are, and what weakens your work.**

symbols.title: “Drop anything” = fastest start
symbols.sub: Drag any file onto the site and we put it in place

symbols.title: Orange = research progress
symbols.sub: Share of stages done with proof

symbols.title: “Before your supervisor sees it”
symbols.sub: The most important fixes, ranked

/drop.name: Drop anything
/drop.lead: A file, photo, message or link. **We read it and show you where it goes before saving.**

symbols.title: The vessel = we're reading
symbols.sub: Three steps show how far we are

symbols.title: “Sure” or “Check it”
symbols.sub: Each card says how confident we are

symbols.title: “Undo” = puts it all back
symbols.sub: As long as nobody edited it

/research-search.name: Search
/research-search.lead: Find studies here. **The agent searches; you choose what goes into the library.**

symbols.title: The agent = searches and summarises
symbols.sub: Describe your topic in your own words

symbols.title: “Save” = goes to the library
symbols.sub: And counts as proof for research tasks

symbols.title: The star = strong match
symbols.sub: The study is close to your topic

/evidence.name: Evidence library
/evidence.lead: Every study you found in one place. **Each study here proves the work happened.**

symbols.title: Gold badge = reviewed
symbols.sub: Its details are in the literature table

symbols.title: “No summary” = incomplete
symbols.sub: Fill its row so it counts

symbols.title: Drop a PDF here
symbols.sub: We fill in its details

/literature-review.name: Literature review
/literature-review.lead: Your studies table: country, design, sample, finding. **Your research gap comes from it.**

symbols.title: Each row = a study
symbols.sub: e.g. 312 nurses, cross-sectional

symbols.title: Empty cell = missing
symbols.sub: Fill it from the study file

symbols.title: “Gap” = what nobody studied
symbols.sub: It comes from comparing rows

/proposal.name: Proposal
/proposal.lead: Write the proposal section by section. **Each section has an owner, and your supervisor comments on the text itself.**

symbols.title: Name next to a section = its owner
symbols.sub: A section with no name gets no writer

symbols.title: Gold = done
symbols.sub: Grey = not started

symbols.title: Supervisor comment
symbols.sub: Appears next to the line it refers to

/methodology.name: Methodology
/methodology.lead: Design, sample, tool and analysis. **Every decision here shapes what you collect later.**

symbols.title: The map = methodology steps
symbols.sub: Tap any step to open it

symbols.title: Gold = ready
symbols.sub: The rest needs filling

symbols.title: “Measurement tool”
symbols.sub: Link it from the tools library

/ethical-approval.name: Ethical approval
/ethical-approval.lead: The approval steps until it's granted. **The approval number proves it's done.**

symbols.title: Steps in order
symbols.sub: Each finished step turns gold

symbols.title: Approval number
symbols.sub: You can't start collecting without it

symbols.title: Forms
symbols.sub: Ready to fill and print

/collect.name: Collect & analyse
/collect.lead: Survey, data and results. **Every response that arrives is counted automatically.**

symbols.title: Stations = collection stages
symbols.sub: From survey to analysis

symbols.title: Counter = responses received
symbols.sub: e.g. 120 responses from 3 hospitals

symbols.title: Statistics
symbols.sub: Come straight from the data

/chat.name: Chat
/chat.lead: Your team chat instead of WhatsApp. **Any message can become a task or a meeting in one tap.**

symbols.title: @ = mention someone
symbols.sub: They get notified

symbols.title: Long press = options
symbols.sub: Task, reminder, question for the supervisor

symbols.title: Summary on top
symbols.sub: Catches you up on what you missed

/tasks.name: My tasks
/tasks.lead: Everything on the team. **Every task is linked to a place**, and when you finish it we see the proof ourselves.

symbols.title: Gold box = done with proof
symbols.sub: e.g. 5 studies are in the library

symbols.title: Gold outline = no proof
symbols.sub: Tap “Add proof” to fix it

symbols.title: “Before your supervisor sees it”
symbols.sub: The most important fixes, ranked

/team.name: Team
/team.lead: Team members and supervisor. **Who's with you, and who's working now.**

symbols.title: Dot next to a name = online
symbols.sub: Working on the site now

symbols.title: Load = how many tasks
symbols.sub: Rebalance if someone has more

symbols.title: Invite your supervisor
symbols.sub: They see everything without an account

/timeline.name: Timeline
/timeline.lead: Your research stages over time. **See if you're behind before you are.**

symbols.title: A bar = a stage
symbols.sub: From its start to its due date

symbols.title: Gold = done
symbols.sub: Orange = now

symbols.title: The line = today
symbols.sub: Everything before it should be done

/meeting-minutes.name: Meetings & supervisor
/meeting-minutes.lead: Minutes, decisions and appointments. **Your supervisor's words become tasks, and minutes are approved in one tap.**

symbols.title: “Start new minutes”
symbols.sub: The mic writes, decisions collect themselves

symbols.title: “Approved” = supervisor agreed
symbols.sub: And it's saved as a PDF in Drive

symbols.title: Decisions for the supervisor
symbols.sub: A question with options, answered in one tap

/meet.name: Video meeting
/meet.lead: Team meetings inside the site. **What's said is transcribed, and decisions go to the minutes.**

symbols.title: Gold outline = connected
symbols.sub: Who's in the meeting now

symbols.title: The hand = wants to speak
symbols.sub: Everyone sees it

symbols.title: Screen sharing
symbols.sub: Show a file to everyone

/feedback.name: Supervisor notes
/feedback.lead: Everything your supervisor said in one place. **Any note can become a task.**

symbols.title: Each card = a note
symbols.sub: With the section it refers to

symbols.title: “Make it a task”
symbols.sub: Goes to tasks with its owner

symbols.title: Gold = resolved
symbols.sub: And your supervisor sees it

/calendar.name: Calendar
/calendar.lead: Team, supervisor and submission dates. **Everything on its date.**

symbols.title: Orange = deadline
symbols.sub: Don't miss it

symbols.title: Gold = meeting
symbols.sub: With the supervisor or the team

symbols.title: Add it to your phone
symbols.sub: Get a reminder before it

/files.name: Files
/files.lead: Team files and Drive. **One file instead of ten copies on WhatsApp.**

symbols.title: Drive = team folder
symbols.sub: Every approved minutes file is saved there

symbols.title: “From a drop” = came from Drop
symbols.sub: With the place it went to

symbols.title: Latest on top
symbols.sub: Sorted newest first

/learn.name: Learn Wesync
/learn.lead: Short lessons that complete themselves when you do them. **Each lesson is a real step in your research.**

symbols.title: Gold = done
symbols.sub: Counted automatically from your work

symbols.title: Counter = lessons done
symbols.sub: e.g. 10 of 16

symbols.title: “Show me”
symbols.sub: Points to the button on the page itself

/start.name: Started already?
/start.lead: If you started before Wesync. **Bring your work and your steps count as done with proof.**

symbols.title: Where you are
symbols.sub: Picks your first screen

symbols.title: Bring what you've done
symbols.sub: Proposal, studies, WhatsApp, Drive

symbols.title: The file = the proof
symbols.sub: Every step you bring counts as done

/explain.name: What is this place?
/explain.lead: Wesync in a minute. **6 places, in the order you'll use them.**

symbols.title: Numbers = the order
symbols.sub: From searching to collecting data

symbols.title: “e.g.” = a real example
symbols.sub: From nursing teams like yours

symbols.title: The only rule
symbols.sub: Everything with proof
